bull_bear.body: Prioritizing organic growth (Durg, NE, Kutch); NECEM acquisition liabilities settled (INR12.5cr), remaining consideration (INR10cr non-compete + INR4cr equity) to close in Q1FY27; Dividend policy not discussed.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Sustained Middle East conflict driving fuel costs; Delay in Nagaur due to Supreme Court Aravalli ruling; Pricing power inability to pass through INR400/ton cost hike; Clinker availability constraint (93% util) mitigated by blended ratio improvement (62% -> 65%+).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Cautiously optimistic on volume (>industry growth) but transparent on margin compression; Confident on long-term 30MT goal despite Assam mining setback; Defensive on cost mitigation levers.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Derecognition of INR325cr intangible assets (mining rights) due to AMDCL contract cancellation in Assam, yet management confirms viability of NE plant via 2 alternative auctioned mines (250MT reserves); RMC growth deliberately curbed to focus on higher-margin non-cement products like adhesives.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Cement volume driven by housing/infra; Non-cement (INR169cr) includes high-margin adhesives/tile solutions; RMC (INR82cr) growth deliberately slowed to protect margins; AAC blocks (INR59cr) on plan.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- [Promoter structure] The Company states it has only one Promoter, namely Bengal & Assam Company Limited, and that Dwarkesh Energy Limited is a Promoter Group entity and not a Promoter as IiAS had reported; Smt. Vinita Singhania is described as a constituent of the Promoter Group and not the Promoter.
- [AGM / Governance] IiAS recommended AGAINST Item 5 of the AGM Notice — re-appointment of Smt. Vinita Singhania as Chairperson & Managing Director for five years from 01 August 2026 with remuneration fixed as minimum remuneration — citing (G) Governance Concern and (T) Weak Transparency; the Company asked IiAS to change the recommendation from AGAINST to FOR and issue an Addendum.
- [Remuneration framework] The Company states the total remuneration (Fixed and Variable) of Smt. Vinita Singhania together with the Dy. Managing Director (Shri Shrivats Singhania) and President & Director (Dr. Arun Kumar Shukla) shall be within the permitted limit of 10% of Net Profit for all managerial personnel under Section 197 of the Companies Act, 2013, with minimum remuneration and no commission in the event of loss or inadequate profits under Section IV of Part II of Schedule V.
- [Variable pay] The Company declines to quantify a cap: it states that since it is difficult to project future profits, neither the Commission nor an absolute cap on variable pay can be quantified at this stage, and that the Performance Linked Incentive is only an enabling approval as the Company presently does not have any PLI Scheme.
- [NRC process] The Company states Smt. Vinita Singhania abstained when her remuneration and re-appointment were discussed in the Nomination & Remuneration Committee (chaired by an Independent Director) and that the matter was approved by all the Independent Directors forming part of the NRC, hence no conflict of interest.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Fuel cost surge: Petcoke +40% QoQ (~$160/ton), Coal +30% QoQ; Guided cost increase INR300/ton (energy) + INR80-100/ton (packaging); Mitigation via fuel mix change in North, renewable energy (46% mix), AI/ML in pyro/grinding.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: Volume growth > industry (est. 6-6.5%); Margin: Expect INR100-130/ton cost hit in Q1FY27, full INR380-400/ton impact by Q2; Order Inflow: N/A; Capex/Commissioning: FY27 INR1,500-1,700cr, FY28 INR2,000cr, FY29 INR1,000-1,500cr. Durg expansion (clinker+grinding) by FY28 end, NE project FY29, Kutch FY30.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: N/A for cement; Capacity utilization currently 73% (FY26), Surat plant >60% utilized, targeting 70%+ soon.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: 30MT capacity target by 2030 (from ~18MT now); Durg expansion (East), Northeast greenfield (Assam based on 2 auctioned mines, 250MT reserves), Kutch (FY30), Nagaur (delayed due to Aravalli SC ruling).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: JK Lakshmi navigates a severe Q4 cost shock (petcoke +40% QoQ) with limited pricing power, compressing EBITDA/ton to ~INR730, while aggressively pursuing a INR5,500+ crore capex plan to reach 30MT by 2030 despite the derecognition of INR325 crore intangible assets from the cancelled Assam mining contract.
